edit.text: As head of the Royal Guard under Maximus, Auran leads the hunt for Black Bolt on Earth and tries to lure him back using Declan and Sammy.
edit.whoA: The king she hunts on Earth for Maximus.
edit.whoB: Maximus's guard, who hunts him on Earth.

add.title: Inhumans
add.text: Disillusioned with Maximus, Auran deserts him and joins Black Bolt's evacuation of Attilan's people to Earth.
add.whoA: The king whose evacuation she joins.
add.whoB: Maximus's former guard, who joins his people.

pairs.source: Wikipedia, Inhumans (TV series), episode 8 '...And Finally: Black Bolt': "Disillusioned, Auran deserts Maximus and joins the evacuation." Episode 5: "Auran ... decides to use Declan and Sammy to lure back Black Bolt." The old stage told the turn inside its enemy stage.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger
add.text: While Tandy and Tyrone go after Andre in the Loa dimension, Mayhem guards Evita and the candle that keeps their way back open, fighting off shadow soldiers. Afterward Tandy asks her to clear Tyrone's name, and Mayhem leaves Connors's body at the police station as Billy's killer.
add.whoA: Mayhem, who guards their way home and clears Tyrone's name.
add.whoB: The young hero she backs up against Andre.

pairs.source: Wikipedia, Cloak & Dagger season 2, 'Level Up': "O'Reilly arrives to defend Evita from shadow soldiers" ... "O'Reilly drops Connors' body off at the police station with a sign that says 'guilty' on him". MCU Wiki 'Level Up': "Mayhem knocks out multiple spiritual entities that came to kill Fusilier" ... "Dagger asks Mayhem for a favor, to clear Johnson's name" ... "Mayhem hangs James Connors body in the police precinct, with a note saying he murdered Billy Johnson".

edit.text: Detective Terri Lee hunts the vampire Morbius and helps Spider-Man and Blade stop him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: Terri blames Morbius for a new wave of plasma attacks and sets out to destroy him, until he saves the Black Cat from the real attacker, Blade's mother Miriam. Terri then joins Spider-Man, the Black Cat, Whistler and Morbius to stop Miriam turning people into vampires.
add.whoA: Detective Lee, who hunts him, then fights beside him.
add.whoB: Morbius, the vampire she hunts, then fights beside.

pairs.source: Marvel Database, Spider-Man (1994 animated series) Season 4 7 'The Vampire Queen': "Terri Lee assumes that Morbius is the culprit" ... "Miriam tries to drain Black Cat's plasma, but she is saved when Morbius appears" ... "Her plan is foiled by the arrival of Spider-Man, Black Cat, Whistler, Morbius and Terri". Terri Lee (Earth-92131): met Blade "while she was trying to stop Morbius" (Season 2 eps 9-10).
